sso.title: SSO Settings
sso.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this login integration? This action cannot be undone.
sso.enabledHint: Enable this login integration for login
sso.allowSignupHint: Allow automatic user creation on first login
sso.requireApprovalHint: Require admin approval for new SSO users
sso.credentialsHint: Secrets such as client_secret are encrypted on the server and never returned. Omit a key or leave its value blank to preserve the saved secret.
sso.invalidCredentialsJson: Credentials must be a JSON object with string values
sso.attributeMappingHint: Map provider attributes to user fields. Values support dot notation (e.g. user.email) or JSONPath (e.g. $.emails[0].value)
sso.invalidProviderName: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores
sso.invalidIconUrl: Icon URL must start with http:// or https://
sso.addProviderDescription: Configure a new login integration for user authentication
sso.disconnectConfirm: Are you sure you want to disconnect this account?
sso.cannotDisconnect: Cannot disconnect the only authentication method
sso.linkAccountsDescription: Bind a Feishu identity to this account so you can sign in with it.
sso.linkableEmpty: No enabled Feishu login is available to link. Ask an administrator to enable Feishu user login, or sync your directory identity.
sso.linkableLoadFailed: Failed to load available Feishu login
